about.label: About me
body: I live in Ankara and work as a frontend developer at InspireIT. Before that, I worked at GuruDesk and started out with a web development internship at Bilgeweb.
I’m interested in the point where a design becomes a working interface in the browser. I use React, Vue and Astro to build new pages, improve existing products and solve performance problems.
I like spending time on the details. The response of a button, the way a page works on a phone and where an animation ends all matter to me.

items.name: Interfaces
items.what: Marketing sites, web apps and dashboards.
items.how: I turn designs into responsive pages and build shared elements as reusable components.
items.when: You need a new website or a working interface for your app.
items.honesty: If you have a design, I’ll build from it. If not, we can work it out together.

items.name: Improvements
items.what: Slow pages and interfaces that have become difficult to maintain.
items.how: I measure the problem first, then update the code and check the result again.
items.when: Your site loads slowly on a phone or small changes take too long.
items.stack: Lighthouse, Web Vitals, profiling, accessibility audits
items.honesty: I look at the existing code before suggesting a large change.

items.name: Animation
items.what: Scroll animations, page transitions and small interactions.
items.how: I keep motion tied to the content, then check it on mobile and with reduced motion enabled.
items.when: You want to explain a product or idea through movement on the page.
items.stack: GSAP ScrollTrigger, Lenis, CSS scroll-driven animation
items.honesty: The dial on this page is a small example of the approach.

items.name: Parley
items.summary: An AI chat that answers with more than text. Ask about the weather and a forecast card appears; ask for a calculation and you get the exact result. Replies stream in as they are written.
items.detail: Built with Nuxt 4 and Nuxt UI, it runs entirely on Cloudflare’s free tier. Turnstile, signed sessions and rate limits keep the AI quota for real visitors.
items.stack: Nuxt 4 · Nuxt UI · AI SDK · Workers AI · TypeScript
items.alt: Parley answering a question about the weather in Istanbul with a forecast card and a calculation card.
items.altMobile: Parley on a phone, showing the local time in Tokyo.
